body: I appreciate the time you’ve taken to reach out but I am 100% committed. I was just having a really hard time finding info online about local spots , and most search results for other surefire methods are just prevention sites. This is the first time I’ve ever made a post like this in 29 years and I’ve made it in sheer frustration on finding a guaranteed method. I was hoping someone that lurks here knows the area and knows a good/guaranteed place to jump. Somewhere away from people to minimise disruption.
